_label: FREEZE CANDIDATE, NOT AUTHORIZED. Revision 4 of the evaluation v2 plan, for senior comment KAN-106 10849. No model run is authorized. The document and this file must agree (bench/kan106-eval-v2/plan-check.js); any disagreement REFUSES launch.

changes: candidate: 2150ab6 + KAN-118 (PR #35 @ 5ebb8c8) merged as f1ddad4; compiler and harness hashes regenerated

keep-alive policy: warm admission requires the pinned model to stay resident for the whole item ceiling (1260 s), which needs the owner to set OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE for the window; otherwise the cold rule; unplanned reloads detected and reported
Mac-first: P-Mac is the only authorized-to-stage profile; P-Linux optional, separately authorized later, never pooled
qb_under_test.sha stays null (senior sets it); proposed value recorded outside normative; the launch head must descend from it and differ only in plan.json, held-out/ and docs/
the 11 GiB cold figure is a provisional conservative admission assumption; insufficient memory = resource_blocked/incomplete, never a model failure
pinned historical rescore accepted; CI reproduces it in a dedicated job that fetches e5c460d explicitly; current-validator drift kept as a separately labelled file

held_out.called: a fresh owner-authored engineering set, not a blinded benchmark

gates.q4_basis: full elapsed L1 time (l1_ms), cold load included

darwin.available: (vm_stat Pages free + Pages inactive) x page size

resource_gate.insufficient_memory: resource_blocked: profile incomplete, never a model failure

keep_alive.owner_sets: OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=-1 (or a duration >= 21m) on the Ollama server for the window
keep_alive.basis: child_timeout_ms 1200 s + 60 s margin: the expiry timer runs only while the model is idle and is reset after each request, so 1260 s remaining covers the whole item even with no call
keep_alive.otherwise: cold rule (a possible reload is charged in full)

P-Mac.status: staged first (packet and window still to be authorized)

P-Linux.status: optional; not scheduled; needs its own authorization; never pooled with P-Mac

notes.cold_runtime_estimate: 11 GiB = weights 8,988,124,298 B (Q4_K_M file; /api/tags size) + f16 KV cache 48 layers x 8 KV heads x 128 dims x 2 (K,V) x 2 B x 8192 tokens = 1.5 GiB + compute buffers, rounded up. An estimate, NOT measured: measuring needs a model load, which is a model call. Disk size alone is never the requirement.
notes.keep_alive_source: Ollama main, fetched 2026-11-27: server/sched.go processCompleted (expireTimer = time.AfterFunc(sessionDuration) / Reset when refCount reaches 0; expiresAt = now + sessionDuration), useLoadedRunner (expireTimer.Stop() when a request reuses the runner; sessionDuration replaced only if the request sends keep_alive), envconfig.KeepAlive (default 5m; OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE as a Go duration or seconds; negative = infinite; 0 = none). NOT verified against the pinned server version: re-check its source/version before launch.
notes.linux: P-Linux is optional; no Linux host is assumed to exist. Its frozen minimum would be 15 GiB (a 16 GB host reports about 15.6 GiB).
